notes.title: Out of Early Access! And Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29302863/54926f0e5ba7cf56e063ecdc87b21ee5f5d35bf7.jpg

Greetings, fellow Adventurers!

It's been a while, isn't it? We have been working very hard on the next big update that will... Well, the title says it all... Just One Line has left Early Access and is officially a fully released title now! Cheers, all hail the King!
We are profoundly moved and excited about this date and we hope you are excited too! You got to be!
It is worth noting though, that this is a huge milestone for Just One Line but it is not nearly the end of its story! We have envisioned JOL as an ever-growing game both in updates and in its content. We could have gone on forever developing and adding new content, but we realized that the game is solid and it fulfills most of the expectations you and us have set. We believe Just One Line is now ready, solid, stable, polished and rich in content. We will continue to update and patch the game but it is also your turn, Adventurers, to make this game even better: you have the tools (Quest Editor, Contests, etc) and a community to join (Discord and the Steam Community Hub)!

But that's not just like "Hey, we are leaving Early Access" and that's it. Not at all! We said we feel the game is ready for its big time, but that would not be true without a huge update to back it up! In fact, we are glad to announce that we have just shipped the biggest update we have ever shipped to our game! Get ready for Just One Line version 1.0.1!

(We realize that there are quite a lot of exclamation marks in the present announcement... but we could barely contain the excitement. We hope you feel the same! Darn, there it is one more.)

Please note: Early Access game saves and profile progress are still compatible. However, if you have a game session with an active adventurer, we recommend to start anew to fully benefit from the new update

Here is the update changelog:

New localizations:

Polish
Russian

New quests

Arcane Tournament
Wild Hunt
The Call

New backgrounds unlockable:

Druid
Mage

All backgrounds and races are now unlockable.
New location:

The lighthouse

Skin and Variants:

Salamander robe
Storm robe
Lightning spell
Fireball spell
Hawk
Thunderstriker
Spellbook of fire
War axe
Tomahawk
Steel Finger
Boiling Magma
Wooden sword

New titles
New achievements
Huge overall balancing and fine tuning


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29302863/29bd03c63bf89fd2a8532e2e80bbef78f382620a.png

Just One Line now features:

18 Quests (accounting for more than 120,000 words and 1,000 distinct choices)
A story-driven experience in which most of your actions have real consequences on the future of your adventurer.
A Quest Editor
Online Leaderboard
47 Weapons + 14 Skins
26 Armors + 13 Skins
4 Races
10 Backgrounds
95 earnable titles
Localized in English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazilian), Polish, Russian, Spanish
Adventurer customization with more than 15,000 unique combinations
Achievements and Trading Cards


Please note: Just One Line is currently on a -15% launch discount. When the discount ends the real price will be higher the the current shown one -which was only  for Early Access customers.

JOIN THE TEAM!
Would you like to be a part of the JOL Studios team? We are looking for great game masters. If you love to write stories and aventurers and to role-play (of course!), the JOL QUEST EDITOR will be your best friend!
Try the Quest Editor, play with it and submit your adventures. We will choose the best and we will bring them to the game! The more talented will be choosen as parterns of JOL Studios.
Bring it on, Adventurers! You might be the JOL Master we are looking for!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29302863/88ca581f43a240a7bef59409a73b73b4cba82b23.jpg


So then... this is the end of an -Early- era... and the beginning of an amazing new Adventure. Come and join us in the Kingdom, Adventurers! The future is bright and full of fun! But as always... The choice is Yours!

The humble servants of the King,
- JOL Studios

notes.title: Demo Version & Game Balance (patch 0.12)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29302863/dd8504073e8a7ecff8297bf435f2dea076e66bea.jpg

Greetings Adventurers,

Today's announcement is very hot!
Get ready for a whole new game experience in Just One Line thanks to many changes in the game balance. We are calling it "The Prohibitionist Update" as it shifts focus from relying -almost entirely- on drinks for power-ups to switching and upgrading gear instead. The Armory inventory has been completely updated in stats and prices in order to improve the longevity of the game and to set targets (weapons, armors or trinkets) for the players to reach more gradually than before. The game should feel more "right", challenging and rewarding now.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29302863/20c4a53e38876a75770282a58cf88fa2a4a3e1ec.jpg

This is our first attempt to achieve the best game balance possible but it will not be the last. As the quest library grows many other changes will be made along the way. If you have not been visiting the Inn for a long while, this is your great opportunity to play Just One Line once again! We will wait for your feedback and thoughts on our Community Hub and Discord. And if you happen to be a new player, your opinion matters as much!
Please Note: we advise to retire any active Adventurer and start a new game altogether to fully appreciate the changes of this update, even if you just started a new game before the update. Should you encounter any major blocking issue, try using a different user profile or reset the profile in use.

A new weapon is available as a sword variant in the Armory: the Night's Scar. The Night's Scar was designed by the player Zeed in our first "Draw a New Weapon for Just One Line" (Facebook) Contest.
Kudos to Zeed! And thank you to all who participated!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29302863/c2a6b0dcb7e851df8362fe2a8de9eb37be239358.jpg

If you want to create new content for the game too, keep following us on our social media and Steam Community Hub for future contests!

We have made a new awesome Steam Trailer for Just One Line:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4cRD6LjpjO8
What do you think, Adventurers? Do you like it better than the previous one?

Last but not the least, we have just made available the demo version of Just One Line, for any one of you Adventurers who are still feeling unsure about our game. Come and try firsthand what Just One Line can offer!
The demo lets the player embark on three epic quests from the full game with four unlocked backgrounds and three unlocked races to choose from when creating your characters. Demo players will not be able to retire their adventurers nor the send them to the leaderboard. The Armory will not have as many items as the full game. But, hey!, it is just a demo, isn' it?

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29302863/34906d3aa1d07d4145f108480e1379f84d1c6f47.png

Here is the complete changelog for the patch 0.12:

"Prohibitionist" Game Balance
- Quests

Duration (days) updated.
Location association changed.
Rewards updated.
Renown for completing the quests updated.
Questboard spawn requirements adjusted.

- Armory

Items' stats and prices drastically changed.
Shields grant damage reduction.
Sword and mace categories have been swapped.
Axe damage type has been changed to be more effective against heavily armored foes.

- Gameplay

Starting gold to 100.
Proficiencies swapped between Herald and Rogue.
Damages and HP do not get affected by attributes increase due to the equipment (weapons, armors or trinkets) and drinks.
Damage reduction given by weapons and armors does not affect any type of damage received outside of combat. Damage reduction obtained by drinks and trinkets stack with that of masteries for damages received outside of combat damages.
Mastery update: Shield Brother's mastery is now 2 damage reduction from fight-type damages received outside of combat.
Mastery update: Hounds' +1 Damage now shows in the damage count.


Other changes:

Weapon Variant: the Night's Scar sword is now available. Night's Scar was designed by Zeed, the winner of our first Facebook "Draw a new weapon" contest.
Weapon: new pose of the adventurer when equipped with the arquebus.
Character creation: locked backgrounds are now dimmer/more transparent when selected.
Main menu: news carousel revamped with banner images, arrows and social icons.
Main menu: snow effect removed from the overworld.
Quest typos corrected.
Other fixes: fix to the title drawing system, minor fix to the tutorial system, armory (disable incompatible trinkets and potions when returning from a quest). 


The King's humble servants,
- JOL Studios.

notes.title: Dwarfs, Linux, Quests and more! (Patch 0.11)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29302863/ccd9645006b99f5fba6bffdeb323070cafe79265.jpg

Greetings fellow Adventurers!

Not long ago we released a new quest and it was a big deal... Get ready to be definitely thrilled now. Unsheathe your weapons, prepare your spells, disguise yourselves and join us for a drink at the Tavern! Today's patch is huge, in fact, it is the biggest we have ever published so far.

A new race is now available: the Dwarf! In fact, this update mainly revolves around Dwarfs.

Here is the Patch 0.11 complete changelog:

Game Port

 GNU/Linux (thus SteamOS) version is now available!


Unlocks

 Race: Dwarf.
 Background: Herald.


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29302863/4e8cb63f3bbb4aac543caa23fe9c0b80226b5a8a.png

New Quests

 "Un-arranged" Marriage.
 Alchemical Supplies.


Time-rifted Quests
(Quests already in the game that are revamped with new branches and/or randomly occurring side events)

 Trouble with Bandits.
 Laments in the Cemetery.
 Rats in the Basement.


Location

 Dwarven Entrance.


Titles and Achievements

 4 titles.
 2 new achievements. ("Snooper!" and "Trickster")


Game Items

 3 beards.
 2 skins (Constable armor and Arquebus)
 1 variant (the Pickaxe)


Bugfixes, Changes, Misc

 In-game credits updated.
 The bulletin tab is now first in the innkeeper window.
 Quests in the diary are now listed from top to bottom.
 Many typos fixed and minor text changes (Dragon, Dragon Hunt, Laments in the Cemetery, Goblin Invasion, Fallen Brother).
 Leaderboard: rank values fixed.
 Adventurer rotation in the paperdoll (creation menu) now resets properly when the player changes race.
 Shop: changing skin/variant right after a shop notice (not enough gold, etc) resulted in unexpected behaviors.


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29302863/16a0d5d15e4bf16705637cfa8724937817f5ef56.png

See you all in the Tavern, Adventurers!
- The King's humble servants.

Greetings Adventurers!

Great news for you all waiting for new quests and stories! With today's patch we are releasing a brand new quest: Goblin Invasion. But that's not the end of story.  Goblin Invasion.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.10.8.1 Released! (Armory Bug)
notes.notes:
Greetings Adventurers!

We have received bug reports regarding the Armory accidentally broken in yesterday's patch 0.10.8. We are sorry for the inconvenience and we have finally published the hotfix. The equipment system broke when trying to buy the Hunter's bow (base skin), but this is no longer the case!
Should you notice anything still wrong in the Armory/Equipment, please fill in a bug report in the Steam Community Hub, on our Discord or send us an e-mail.
Thank you for your patience and understanding!

-The King's humble servants.

notes.title: Skin Pack I - Commoner & Patch 0.10.6
notes.notes:
Greetings Adventurers!
As of today, we start rolling out weapons & armors Skin Packs. This first Skin Pack targets the Commoner background by adding 3 weapon skins and 2 armor skins to the game.
We will soon publish our public roadmap.

Do not forget to join our Discord.

Changelog:

 Skins: skins now have a proper name.
 Skins: Pitchfork, Sickle, Dagger.
 Skins: Padded armor.
 Commoner Skill: update to the "Change Your Destiny" user interface.
 Commoner Skill: if you change background while equipped with items with which your new background is not proficient (armor or weapon, namely the pitchfork), you will sell them back for half their shop price.
 Shop: Tooltips added to the damage/hitpoints/damage reduction/attributes bonus icons.
 Stats Screen: Tooltips added to the damage/hitpoints/damage reduction/attributes icons.
 Day Counter: day counter bug fixed (sometimes it reset to 1).
 Saving: animated saving icon now has a bumping effect.
 Text: stats & retirement, Potion -> Drink.

notes.title: Upcoming Quest Update and Patch 0.10.5 released
notes.notes:
Greetings Adventurers!

Today we are proud to announce the forthcoming release of a new quest-related update: Time Rift!
The update will contain a new compelling quest introducing a new game mechanic: random events! This feature will let you embark on ever-changing quests, so that even the ones you know best will contain unexpected paths, while the most observant adventurers (or the most lucky) could even sense something strange happening in the Kingdom...
Since we are not satisfied with just this and we care about your request for more quest variety in Just One Line, we decided to add this feature to the other quests already in the game too! Starting with the first Time Rift update, some quests will be updated with the new feature and the new ones will be created with this new design in mind.
In the meanwhile, here is today's patch changelog:


 Achievement and Titles: bug fix and allocation for new ones.
 Texts: [Italian only] typos fixed.
 Save file: loading a profile containing newly released quests could block the loading.


- The humble servants of the Kingdom

notes.title: Patch 0.10.4 released.
notes.notes:
Greetings Adventurers!

   Thank you for being part of this amazing Community!
Today we are rolling out our first update to the game quests: the Fistfights in the Tavern quest has been expanded with new story-paths! Have fun with the new choices available!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29302863/3cf7cbf921448d834eb919c008b1357526b6afba.png

Here is the complete changelog:

 Quest: new story-paths in "Fistfights in the Tavern".
 Achievement: new achievement in "Fistfights in the Tavern".
 Quest: you can now "collect" the reward from the old Renny (Rats in the Basement) in Fistfights in the Tavern. (Thanks to nerd_o_tron and to legionsama972)
 Armors: new skins for Brigandine and Arch-enchanter.
 Weapons: new skins for the Double Axe and the Broadsword.
 Texts: typos and localization issues in the tutorials, help and "Fistfights in the Tavern" quest have been fixed. (Thanks to Viiyen)


- The humble servants of the Kingdom

notes.title: Patch 0.10.2 released.
notes.notes:
Greetings Adventurers!
Here's the latest patch changelog (v 0.10.2):

 Trouble with Bandits: typos fixed. (Thanks to RabidUrko and to Kyalome)
 Achievements: removed the in-game (non-Steam) unlock pop-up for an achievement (Evil) not present in the game. (Thanks to Kyalome)
 Sound Effects: new sound effect when buying/equipping a magic item.
 Sound Effects: the sound effect played when equipping an item does not play the coin effect anymore. (Thanks to TheTreeHugger)
 Retirement Interface: update the retirement section user interface.
 Font: now the same font is used in the profiles titles. The same red tint is now used across the whole game user interface.
 Localization: [Ita] translated in Italian the message displayed when your adventurer dies (previously displayed in English).
 Leaderboard (Retirement): add link to the User Agreement.
 Credits: add credits to Techs (Steamworks NET, Fungus).
 Game System: (under the hood) add new handles for upcoming quests.
 Leaderboard System: Important! We have added a new feature to the leaderboard, you can now write a biography of the Adventurer you want to retire (up to 1500 characters long). It is an optional field: if not provided, no entry is created. Please Note: Read the User Agreement. (Thanks to Alwaysmadowl for suggesting us this feature. If you want to be the next one to suggest us a new feature, head to our game Community Hub or send us an e-mail!)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29302863/067d364cd2ca41af69354263ad1d5a8c3c253c4b.jpg
Note: the biography icon is only displayed for the adventurers who have a biography.

We have just released a new patch (0.10.1):

notes.title: Skin System! (version 0.10.0)
notes.notes:
Skin System

Greetings Adventurers,

   your favorite shopkeeper has some new epic items to sell. Go check the Little Horn's Inn Armory. Also, be sure to bring some gold with you!

As for patch 0.10.0, we just rolled out our first implementation of the weapons and armors skin system. We will be adding more and more contents as the time goes by and we get more confident of the stability of the system.
We carefully developed a small skin content pack for you:

Weapons

 Club x1

Armors

 Settler Suit x1
 Habit x2
 Scoundrel Suit x1


Items with one or more skins will be distinguishable by their blue label in the list, and you can switch their skins by pressing the next/previous buttons in the right side of the Armory. The skin names are just a placeholder at the moment, we will soon change them to something more Just One Line-fashioned.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29302863/f83ad03fa917b3dcb0e66d6843379435a7e5363d.png

The base skin and the new skin(s) of a weapon/armor can be bought independently. You can buy the new skin(s) without buying the base one. You will need to pay for each skin you want (the price is always set equal to the base item value).
Remember: you cannot sell back your items to the shopkeeper in Just One Line!

We cannot wait to see your new adventurers in the leaderboard.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29302863/dcabb7cddec41b3cb7d209304f06410cff18e13d.jpg
